jitam saṃpuṭita na ekaika padam ekaikasmin ko prādakṣiṇyena likhet evam aparipaṃktau ānulomyena daśa padānām samādeśaḥ adha
stana paṃktau prātilomyena punar na eva maṃtra varṇanā ekaike saṃpuṭitānām uparitanānām daśa padānām samādeśaḥ ekādaśa
śakoṣṭe dvādaśa pūritam varṇat varṇa dvayam tatas mukasya rakṣā madhye pāṃrśvayoḥ kuru kuru tadeva varṇa dvayam viparitam likhet evam evam
kaviṃśati koṣṭakānām viniyogaḥ tat eva dvādaśa varṇa ātmakam maṃtram darśayaṃti sva ityādinā sauvarṇa iti ādi yaṃtra śaktiḥ prasiddhā
tiṣṭita iti aṃbham spaṣṭam tatra yāvajjīvam ityādi tāmra patriti etam sarva yaṃtra sādhāraṇam etām ityādi śloka ṣaṭkam yaṃtrāt bahis sthālam vṛ
ttam yathā bhavati tathā likhet śeṣam syaham na saṃti guravaḥ yasya naiva dīkṣā vidhi kramaḥ rāma rakṣām vadante tat tulaśī dalam arpayet
dīkṣā aṃtara śatena api na etat phalam avāpyate iti agastyena ca ukta tvāt rāma rakṣā samam na hi prādakṣiṇya krameṇa ca eti cakāra sūcitā
rtha graṃtha aṃtara uktam draṣṭavyam hasau yaṃtrasya jīvasya ātma dhyam vījāt adhau nyaset haṃsaḥ saḥ ham iti prāṇam īśānyā vikramān likhet
iṃdra netre nyaset pārśve uḍam śrotre tathā eva ca viśeṣa uṣṭa dala ādau tu gāyatrī lekhame smṛtaḥ yaṃtra rājāya vidmahe vara pradāya dhīmahi
pṛ0 55a tat naḥ yantraḥ pracodayāt iti arṇān maṃtra gāyatryāḥ pratipatram triśas likhet agni vā atha avakāśena pratiṣṭām prāṇa dām likhet prayogasāre
bhūmi spṛsṛt śaṃkha spṛṣṭam kliṣṭam nirmālya saṃgatam dagdham ālaṃghinam śīrṇam yaṃtram jātu na dhārayet iti sarva yaṃtra sādhāraṇa kramaḥ iti
aṣṭamam yantram iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācārya śrīmat mukuṃdavana śrī caraṇa śiṣya ānaṃdavana viracitāyām śrī rāmārcana
caṃdrikāyām caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ caitra ādi māsa kṛtyam yadhunā tat prakāśyate rāma bhaktasya siddhartham yat uktam nārada ādibhiḥ madhu
śuklām tṛtīyām ca jānakī ramaṇam prabhum rāja upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya māsam āṃṭolayet kalau dakṣiṇa abhimukham devam dolamānam su
ra īśvaraḥ su pūjitaṃsaka dṛṣṭvā sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyate dolā ārūḍha prapaśyaṃti ye kṛṣṇam madhu mādhave aparādha sahasraiḥ tu muktāḥ tena atra saṃ
śayaḥ sarva puṇya phala avāptiḥ nirmiṣe nimiṣe bhavet iti gāruḍe dolotsavaḥ caitra
śukla navamyām tu karttavyam bratam uttamam agastisahitāyām yat mahatyām samudīritam śrī rāma navamī proktā koṭi sūrya graha adhikā
tasmin dine mahā puṇye rāmam uddiśya bhaktitaḥ yat tiṃcid kriyate karma tat bhavate kṣayam dhruvam upoṣaṇam jāgaraṇam pihan uddiśya tarpa
tasmin dine tu karttṛvyam brahma prāptim abhīpsubhiḥ rāmaḥ eva param brahma tat itam rāma toṣaṇam iti ādinam himā nityam nemittikam kā
myam bratam ca iti vicāryate niṣkāmānām vidhānām tat na kāmyam tāvat iṣyate mumukṣavaḥ aupihi sadā śrī rāma navamī bratam na tyajaṃti su
raśreṣṭā deveṃdraḥ api viśeṣataḥ iti sadā yadasya grahaṇāt etat suti param nahi naimittikam cana tathā sadā iti śrūyate yatas
pṛ0 55ba bhāvyā tvam sadā pārthaḥ na ca anyathā caitra māsena vamyām tu śukla pakṣe raghūttamaḥ prādurāsīt purā brahman para brahmā eva kevalam tasmin dine tu kattavyam
upavāsa bratam sadā iti nityam eva bhavet tasmāt śrī rāma navamī bratam na tu asya syām na nitya tvam pratyakṣa tvāt phala a śruteḥ sūryya grahe kurukṣetre
mahā dānaiḥ kṛtaiḥ muhur yat phalam tat avāpnoti śrī rāma navamī bratāt ityādi mā evam phala śruteḥ nitya lakṣaṇa abhāvataḥ uthavā
tatra na ādyaḥ agnihotra ādau virodhataḥ na antyaḥ api akāraṇe hi asya mahā doṣa śrute sphuṭam prāpte śrī rāma navamī dine marttyaḥ vimūha dhīḥ
ṣaṇam na kurute kuṃbhepākeṣu yacyate yaḥ tu rāma navamyām tu bhuṃkte mohāt vimūḍha dhīḥ kuṃbhīpākeṣu ghoreṣu pacyate na atra saṃśayi tyādi a
taḥ svīkaraṇe doṣa vidhvaṃse nitya tā sthitā kuryāt rāma navamyām yupoṣaṇam ataṃdritaḥ mātuḥ gabham avāpnoti na eva rāmaḥ bhavet svayam
smāt sarva ātmanā sarve kṛtvā eva navamībratam mucyaṃte sarva pāpebhyaḥ yāṃti brahma sanātanam iti pāpa kṣayat dhārā mokṣa artham tvam cagaspate
na saṃyoga pṛthaktvena viruddhe phala nitya te nityānām api darśa ādi yāgānām nitya tā śrute na tu arthavāda rūpam syāt phalam
phalam syāt artha ca ādāya dravyam saṃskāra karmasu pratijñāyām tu na evam myāt vidhi vādhā phale sati saṃskāra tva aṃga karma tva tasya tā
tām iha karmaṇi bhūta bhāvi upayogam hi dravyam saṃskāryyam iṣyate na upayuktaḥ pumān atra śāstrāt vā na upayokṣyate na api aṃga tvam pradhāna
syā śravaṇāt iha kasyacid pradhānam phala saṃvaṃdhi tad yogya aṅgam iti sthiteḥ
ra artha tva nidānam ca tat na eva atra avakalpate na tu arthavāda hīnānām vidhīnām vidhi tā katham artha dvaya para tvena vākyabhedaḥ prasa
jyate mā evam artha dvayam yuktam rātri satra ādi yāgavat tasmāt ati apakṣayat dhārā mokṣa artha tvāt ca nityataḥ nyāya upavṛṃhitāt śāstrāt maṃtavyān yāthavedi
bhiḥ iti rāma janma navamī nityatā sāmānya ūna adhikā ca iti śuddhā api navamī tridhā
nar nakṣatra saṃyoga viyogābhyām tu ṣaḍvidhā sama ādi ṛkṣa yoga avi bhedaiḥ viddhā api ṣaḍvidhā evam dvādaśadhā bhinnā navamī tatra nirṇa
yaḥ mahā phala pradā śuddhā punarvasu ṛkṣa yogataḥ caitra māsena vamyām ca jātaḥ rāmaḥ svayam hariḥ punarvasu ṛkṣa saṃyuktā sa atithiḥ sarva
kāma dā caitra śuddha navamyām tu sa atithiḥ sarva kāma dā śrī rāma navamī proktā koṭi
sūrya graha adhikā caitra śuddhā tu navamī punarvasu yutā yadi sā eva madhyāhna yoge ta mahā puṇyatamā bhavet meṣam pūṣaṇi saṃprāpte lagne karka
āvirāsīt sakalayā kausalyāya aparaḥ pumān iti tasmāt sarva ātmanā sarvaṃkṛt
tvā eva navamībratam iti sarvaiḥ iti sarva eṣām adhikāraḥ prakāśyate vidvā eva ced ṛkṣa saṃyuktā vratam tatra katham bhavet vidvāḥ niṣedha śravaṇāt navamī
ca iti dākyataḥ navamī ca aṣṭamī viddhā tyājyā viṣṇu parāyaṇaiḥ upoṣaṇam navamyām ca e daśamyām eva ṛpareṇam iti
viṣṇu paraiḥ iti daśyam yadi ṣu vṛddhiḥ ced vidvāḥ tyājyā iva vaiṣṇavaiḥ tad anyeṣām tu sarveṣām vratam tatra eva niścitam daśamyām aivaśavdena daśamī na eva laṃgha
yet niścitya evam vicāreṇa navamībratam ācaret iti śrī rāmajanmanavamī nirṇayaḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥ iti vākyāt hit teṣām lakṣaṇam ucyate
mudram sa nyāsam sṛṣi chaṃda devatam sa dīkṣā vidhi sa dhyānam sa yaṃtram dvādaśa akṣaram aṣṭa akṣaram atha anyam vā ye maṃtram samupāsate jñeyāḥ te vaiṣṇava ālokaḥ
pṛ0 56a sadā sa dīkṣā vidhi sāgaṃdā maṃtrarājam sayaṃtrayam sahasra akṣara saṃyuktam mūla vyūha ādi bhedataḥ

yat vā puruṣasūkta ādyaiḥ dīkṣā vidhim ajātataḥ vaidikasya atha bhāve tu nāma maṃtreḥ bhavet dhruvam aṣṭamyām caitra māsasya śukla pakṣe jita iṃdriyaḥ
danta dhāvana pūrve tumnātaḥ trāyāt yathā vidhiḥ tatas saṃdhyā adhikāḥ kuryyāt saṃsmaran rāghavam
pṛ0 57a hṛdi gṛham āgatya vipra indra kuryāt aupāsana ādikam dāntam kuṭuṃvinam vipram veda śāstra āratam sadā śrī rāma pūjā niratam su śīlam dambha varjitam vidhi jñeṃ
rāma maṃtreṇa āṃ rāma maṃtra eka sādhanam āhūya bhaktyā saṃpūjya vṛṇuyāt prārthayan iti śrī rāma pratimā dānam kariṣye ham dvijottama tatra
cāryyaḥ bhava prītaḥ śrī rāmaḥ si tvam eva me iti uktvā ūjyena tam vipram snāpayitvā tatas svayam tailam na abhyakṣya casnāya a ciṃtayan rāghavam hṛ
śveta avara dhara śveta gaṃdha mālyāni dhārayet arcitaḥ bhūṣitaḥ ca eva kṛta madhyāhnika kriyāḥ ācāryyam bhojayet paścāt sattvikā
nnaiḥ su vistaram bhuṃjīta svayam adhyevam hṛdi rāmam anusmaran navamyām aṃga bhūtena eka bhaktena rāghavaḥ ikṣvāku daṃśa tilaka prītaḥ bhava
bhava priyaḥ iti nivedana maṃtraḥ eka bhakta bravīt tatra saha ācārya ūṃjita iṃdriyaḥ śrṛṇvan rāma kathām divyām mahaḥ śeṣam nayet bhune sāyam saṃdhyā
dikāḥ kuryyāt kriyā rāmam anusmaran ācāryya sahitaḥ rātrau adhas śāyī jita iṃdriyaḥ vaset svayam tathā ekāṃte śrī rāma arpitam ā
nasaḥ ācārya karaṇe śaktaḥ svayam bhuktvā svapet sukham iti aṣṭamī kṛtyam tatas prātasam utthāya snātvā saṃdhyām vidhāya ca prātar sarvā
ṇi karmāṇi śīghram eva samāpayet upoṣye navamī tvadya yāmeṣu aṣṭasu rāghava tena prītaḥ bhavatu aṃbho saṃsārāt trā himān hare iti u eva
sa nivedana maṃtraḥ tatas svastha manāḥ bhūtvā vidvadbhiḥ sahitaḥ nagha sva gṛhe ca uttare bhāge yāga maṃḍapam ārabhet catur dvāram patākā āḍhyam
su vitānam su toraṇam manoramam mahā utsedham puṣpa ādyaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam śaṃkha cakra hanumadbhiḥ prāc dvāre samalaṃkṛtam
ṇaiḥ ca dakṣiṇesalaṃkṛtam gadā khaḍga aṅgadaiḥ caidapāḥ ca imesamalaṃkṛtam padma su āsteka nīlaiḥ ca kauveresamalaṃkṛtam madhye hasta catur
pṛ0 57ba ṣka āḍhyam sedikā yuktam āyatam praviśya nṛtya gītaiḥ ca vādyaiḥ ca api su saṃyutam puṇyāham vācayet tatra vidvadbhiḥ pīta mānasaiḥ tatas saṃkalpayet vedikā
vaṃrāmam evam anusmaret asyām rāma navamyām carāma ārādhana tatparaḥ upoṣya aṣṭa stra yāmeṣu pūjayitvā yathā vidhiḥ imām svarṇa maryām rāma

iti tris saṃkalpaḥ śakta aśakta atyaśaktasya mūrti nirmāṇam ucyate tatas svarṇa mayīḥ rāma pratimām pala mānataḥ
nirmitāḥ dvi bhujāḥ divyām vāma aṅga sthita jānakīm vibhratīm dakṣiṇa kare jñāna mudrām mahā mune vāmena adhas kareṇa ārāt devīm ā
liṃgya saṃsthitām siṃhāsane rājatetra paṃla dvaya vinirmite
rddhena vā amune tatas upi aśaktaḥ raupyeṇa kārayet raghunaṃdana lohena nirmitām vā api śilāyāḥ dāruṇā api vā yat vā ālyekhyam vilekhyam
vāma ātura aṃka gatam harim komala aṃgam viśāla akṣam iṃdranīla sama prabham dakṣiṇa aṃge daśarathim putra anveṣaṇa tatparam
kṣmaṇam darve sva chatram kanaka prabham pārśve bharata śatrughnau tālavṛṃta karī ubhau vitta śāṭhya
ma kṛtvā uvamūrttim kuryāt prayatnataḥ na kuryāt vidhi vistaram na tad phalam avāpnoti deveṃdrohaḥ sucya
te iti mūrtti lakṣaṇam āsana upari saṃveśya nyāsa jālam vidhāya ca śaṃkham prapūjayet agre gaṃdha puṣpa akṣata ādibhiḥ kalaśam vāma
bhāga stham pūjā dravyāṇi vā ādarāt pātram ca prokṣayet bhaktyā tvā ātmānam maṃtram uccaran iti śaṃkha pratiṣṭā sarvatobhadram
pṛ0 58a dika upari suṃdaram madhye tīrtha udakaiḥ pūrṇam kumbham ratna udaram śubham cūta pallava puṣpaiḥ ca yuktam saṃsthāpya ca arcitam sauvarṇe rājate tāmre pātreṣu
ṭkoṇam ālikhet alābhe vilva pīṭhe ca a kalaśa upari saṃsthite sthāpya upari vastra yugmam achinnam su daśam tatas divyam siṃha āsa
naṃ tatra sthāpayitvā arcayet sudhīḥ om namaḥ bhagavate viṣṇave sarva bhūta ātmane vāsudevāya sarva ātma saṃyoga yogapīṭha ātmane namaḥ
iti maṃtreṇa kuryyu puṣpāṃjāleṃ punar iti pīṭha arcā arghapādya ādikam dadyāt snānam paṃcāmṛtena ca lepya ādau nau abhiṣekaḥ syāt
iti snānam tatas saṃsthāpya pīṭhe tam pūjām kuryāt yathāvidhi āvāhanam sthāpanam ca sannidhāpanam eva ca sannidhāpanam
rodhanam eva syāt avakuṃṭhanam aṃjasā tad tad mudrābhiḥ evaḥ syāt devam saṃprārthya bhaktitaḥ nānā ratna vicitrāṇi vadyāt ābharaṇāni
ca hima aṃvu ghṛṣṭa rucira ghana māra samanvitam gaṃdham dadyāt prayatnena sa agurum ca sa kuṃkumam kalhāra ketakī jātī puṃnāga ādyaiḥ
prapūjayet caṃdakaiḥ śatapatraiḥ ca sugaṃdhaiḥ su manoharaiḥ cūta pallava puṣpaiḥ ca dūrvābhiḥ tulasī dalaiḥ komalaiḥ vilva patraiḥ ca
aśoka kusumaiḥ tathā rāmasya jananī ca asi rāma ātmakam idam jagat atas tvām pūjayiṣyāmi lokamātar tamoḥ tu te i
ti kauśalya arcā namaḥ daśarathāya iti pūjayet pitaram tatas iti pitṛ pūjanam tatas anujñāpya deveśam parivārān samarcayet pūrvam saḥ
iti prathama āvaraṇam lakṣmaṇa aṃgada śatrughnam jāmbavantam da

traiḥ tu tvā vā prajapan manum śrṛṇvan japaṃtī māhātmyam rāma kathām tathā rāma bhaktaiḥ samam yāmam nayet rāmam anusmaran iti prathama

ra gurau seṃdara eta vamyām tithau lagne karkaṭake punarvasu yute meṣaṃgate pūṣaṇi nirdagdham nikhilāḥ palāśa samidhaḥ madhya udaya udhyaḥ

argha maṃtraḥ punar puṣpa aṃjalim datvā yāma yāma iṣṭha taṃdritaḥ pūjayet vidhivat bhaktyā divārātram nayet vudhaḥ tatas prātasamutthāya snāna saṃdhyā

taḥ bhaktyā su saṃtoṣya ācāryyam pūjayet mune kuṃḍalābhyām su ratnābhyām aṃgulīyaiḥ anekadhā gaṃdha puṣpa akṣataiḥ vastraiḥ vicitraiḥ sumanas

pṛ0 68a gevata hine prāśayet prathamam ca annam tatas bhuṃjīta kāmatas sāyam catuṣka ga śveta chada pīṭha gatān śiśūn nūtna kuṃbha ambhasā ācyūta pallava
vaiḥ abhiṣecayet evam yaḥ kurute pārtha śāstra uktam phālguna utsavam mad prasādāt ca sidhyaṃti tasya sarve manorathāḥ vṛtte tuṣāra samaye
sita paṃcadaśyām prātavaṃsaṃta samaye samupasthite ca saṃprāśya cūta kusumam saha caṃdanena satyam hi pārtha puruṣa ūvda śatam sukhī syāt
iti bhaviṣyottare śrī bhagavat uktaḥ vasaṃta utsavaḥ iti phālguna vṛtyam suvarṇam
ca ājya saṃyuktam trayastriṃśat vapūpakam dadyāt ca veda vidveṣe śrotriyāya kuṭuṃvinam naśyaṃti akaraṇe śīghram puṇyam dvādaśa māsa jam
iti bhaviṣyottare adhika māsa kṛtyam dvādaśasu api māseṣu pakṣayoḥ ubhayoḥ api vidyutsavaḥ prakarttavya ekādaśyām ca jāgaraḥ
daśamyām prātar utthāya kṛta maitra ādikaḥ brabīt deva arcana kriyām kṛtvā kuryyāt saṃkalpam ādṛtaḥ daśamī dinam ārabhya kariṣye
haṃ bratam tava tri dinam deva deva deveśa nirvighnam kurukeśavaḥ iti uccārya arpayet puṣpa aṃjalim śrī rāma pādayoḥ śaṃkha udakena saṃkalpya praṇame
iti daśamī saṃkalpaḥ ekādaśyām tu parṇa āyaiḥ nirvarttya daṃta dhāvanam snātvā deva arcanam kṛtvā brata saṃkalpam ācaret ekādaśī
daśyām nirāhāra sthitvā aham aparehani bhokṣyāmi puṃḍarīkākṣa śaraṇam me bhava acyutaḥ iti ca aṃjali pātreṇa arpayet devala vākyataḥ
gṛhītvā uduṃvaram pātram vāri pūrṇam udak mukhaḥ upavāsam gṛhītvā atha maṃtra pūtam jalam pivet iti ekādaśi saṃkalpaḥ kṛtvā tu āvaśyakam
sarvam dvādaśyā bratam arpayet ajñānam timira aṃdhasya bratena atena keśava prasīda sumukhaḥ nātha jñāna dṛṣṭi pradaḥ bhava iti dvādaśī
saṃkalpaḥ bhaviṣya ukta prakāreṇa kuryāt vi tri dinam bratam prasiddha tvāt tat asmābhiḥ kartṛ tvam na prapaṃcitam
pṛ0 68a tona āgama uditā tad tad śāstrāt tu vijñeyā vaiṣṇavī vaiṣṇavaiḥ naraiḥ prasiddha tvāt na ca ucyaṃte graṃtha vistara bhītitaḥ
siddhasya vistaraḥ caitra ādiṣu uditaḥ svābhiḥ kartṛ tvasya īśa tuṣṭaye vrahma ānaṃde nimagnasya tālam me syāt sthiram manaḥ tvad pāda padma gam
dhenā yathā syāt jānakīpate na kāma tāpaḥ na tatas time yatas prakāśitā te caṃna caṃdrikā iyam tuṣṭaḥ bhavatvam sukṛtena yasmāt te
smāt tvad anyam na hi rāmacaṃdra rāmaḥ asmi it pati yatna dhīra niratam rāmam bhajet tat ṛdheyat rāmeṇa niyuktam etat akhilam rāmāya tat ca arpaye
rāmāt etat abhinnam eva caritam kaḥ vetti rāmasya tat rāmam sarvam idam vilīyati tome rāma sāmyam tanu kārkvaśyam daśa kaṃdharaḥ rakya
yate sat mārdavam maithilī dātṛ tvam ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ vahuvidham sneham punar sāṃpratam
caṃdrikā iyam syāt saṃhitām ārṣam upāśrayadbhiḥ bhava ādibhiḥ nirṇitam auṣadham yyā paṭalaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ proktam śrī rāmārcanacaṃdrikām
naṃdavana nāmnā ahi kavinā hari tuṣṭaye iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācārya śrīmat mukuṃdavana śrī caraṇa śiṣya anaṃdavant
na viracitāyām śrī rāmārcanacaṃdrikāyām paṃcamaḥ paṭalaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ samāptā ca iyam rāmārcanacaṃdrikā saṃvat 1929
